chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abu Abd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) judged regarding a man who bought a slave girl, so he copulated with her, then he found a defect in her. He (peace be upon him) said: 'She is valued while she is healthy, and she is valued with the defect, then the seller returns to the buyer the difference between the healthy value and the defective value.'
ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for a hidden defect in a slave girl after the buyer has copulated with her?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'Ib al-'Uqr' (compensation for defect) in slave sales, specifically addressing the scenario where the buyer consummates the marriage before discovering the flaw. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) rules that the buyer retains the slave and receives a monetary refund equal to the difference in value between her state when healthy and her state with the defect, ensuring fairness despite the change in possession.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Talha Bin Zayd, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding a man who bought a slave girl, so he copulated with her, then he found a defact in her’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would be evaluated as being healthy, and she would be valued with (that) illness. Then the seller would return to the buyer the remainder of what is between the healthy and the ill’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

’Amir al-Mu’minin, in the case of a man who bought a slave-girl and did sexual intercourse with her, then found defect in her, issued a judgment that said, ‘She must be evaluated as perfect as well as defective; then the seller must refund the difference of the two prices to the buyer.’”
